blocks.text: On a chilly October afternoon in Myeong-dong, Seoul’s bustling tourist shopping district, Vietnamese tourist Nguyen Lan was browsing the shelves of a pharmacy for red ginseng, a favorite dietary supplement for many South Koreans. She used Google Translate to ask the pharmacist how much it cost, what its benefits were and when to take it. Although Korean red ginseng is readily available in Vietnam, Nguyen said she preferred buying it in a pharmacy here in person because she felt more confident about its authenticity. “Finding authentic products (in Vietnam) can be difficult because of counterfeit products and mislabeled imports,” Nguyen told […]...
